summary: XORTX Therapeutics files a 6-K announcing a US$5 million public offering of 2,659,574 common shares or pre-funded warrants at US$1.88 per share. The pre-funded warrants have an exercise price of US$0.0001 and are immediately exercisable. E.F. Hutton acts as exclusive placement agent. The offering is under a Form F-1 effective May 13, 2026, with closing expected May 15, 2026, pending TSX Venture Exchange approval. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no strategic event, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved. The filing does not qualify as a special-situation category.
